note: The AI arm. Every session in data/ai/paste_schedule.json is sent as one unsplit message in a fresh, memory-free run on the maker's own subscription tool, with no paid API key: ChatGPT through the Codex CLI on a free ChatGPT login (scripts/run_chatgpt.py) and Claude through headless Claude Code on a Claude Pro login (scripts/run_claude.py). Each run replaces the tool's own instructions with a single line, switches off its tools, and starts from an empty folder; every reply is kept as returned. 'ChatGPT, high reasoning' is the same run setup with Codex's model_reasoning_effort set to high (scripts/run_chatgpt.py --effort high); the default run used no reasoning. 'key' names the reply folder under paste/replies/ and data/ai/raw/. The model version is read from the 'Model:' line of each reply file. The earlier hand-pasted ChatGPT run is archived in chatgpt-pasted/. Gemini is still running (scripts/run_gemini.py) and is not analyzed yet.
